answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce token stake before it may post jobs or vote on reputation updates. A bridge contract records the stake and caps each identity’s influence; proven fraud lets challengers submit evidence and trigger slashing, while honest agents can reclaim their stake after a delay. This does not make Sybils impossible, but multiplying identities now ties up capital and multiplies the attacker’s exposure. A knoll or garden of free accounts no longer buys free influence.
